name: Lakera Red
what_it_does: Commercial automated red-teaming for LLM applications. Continuous, multi-turn adversarial testing with reporting suitable for security teams; pairs with Lakera Guard for runtime protection.
what_it_doesnt_do: Coverage is shaped by Lakera's threat intelligence; if your threat model is unusual, expect to supplement with custom testing. Lock-in concern: paired use with Lakera Guard is common but optional.
best_for: Regulated enterprises wanting commercial accountability and reporting
Continuous testing without building/maintaining the harness in-house
not_for: Teams with strong in-house AI security engineering preferring deep customization
team_skill_required: Moderate technical comfort; configuration over coding.
